## Activity

During May 2019, North City Eye Clinic completed 517 image captures. Activity was delivered in line with the expected session arrangements, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No operational issue affecting the reported activity was identified. The recorded total represents the work completed at the site during the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 sets were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.7. The result is recorded for routine monitoring of image quality and should be considered alongside the grading activity for the same reporting period. The available information indicates that image quality was monitored through the standard review process.

## Grading

A total of 73 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 5. This provides the reported measure of turnaround for grading during May 2019. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures give an overview of service delivery at North City Eye Clinic for the month.
